_metadata.name: Stanford Health Care Discharge Summary (Template A)
_metadata.style: Stanford Hospital & Clinics @SHCRXLOGO@ format — formal, granular, blue section headers, labs grouped into named panels (CBC/Electrolytes/Glucose/Coagulation/LFTs/Cardiac), a 'Discharge Plan, by Issue' problem list, and a 'Best Practice Information' block with the PRISM referring-physician footer.
_metadata.based_on: Stanford Hospital and Clinics 'Discharge Summary' Epic template (Template contents.pdf)
_metadata.content_parity_note: Captures the SAME note-derived clinical facts as template_B — only section/field NAMING, grouping, ordering, lab paneling, and institution-specific STATIC boilerplate differ. Static boilerplate carries no note-derived clinical content, so it does not break content parity. Do not add or remove note-derived content categories relative to template_B.
_metadata.null_convention: Use JSON null (not 'Not provided') for any field absent from the source note.
_metadata.static_convention: A field with a 'static' key is fixed institutional boilerplate emitted verbatim for every note; it is not drawn from and does not depend on the source note.
_metadata.labs_convention: laboratory_studies declares a single mapped 'laboratory' field; restructure.py deterministically groups those values into SHC lab panels (CBC, Electrolytes, Glucose, Coagulation, LFTs, Cardiac, Other) in the output.
_metadata.catch_all: additional_information.clinical_details holds any specialty-specific or uncategorized clinical information so nothing is dropped.

attending_contact_info.static: Stanford Hospital page operator at 650-723-4000 and page the attending physician.

resident_fellow.description: Resident or fellow involved in care, if documented

reason_for_hospitalization.description: Chief complaint and clinical context leading to admission.

history_of_present_illness.description: Clinical narrative leading to admission. Preserve dates, values, and provider names.
history_of_present_illness.example: 64-year-old male presenting with 3 days of productive cough and dyspnea...

surgical_history.description: Prior surgeries with dates if available

social_history.description: Smoking, alcohol, drugs, living situation, occupation

summary_of_hospital_course.description: Narrative overview of the admission. Preserve clinical detail — do not summarize away specifics.

summary.description: 1-3 sentence high-level summary of the admission
summary.example: Admitted for pneumonia, treated with IV antibiotics, improved and discharged home.

response_to_treatment.description: How the patient responded to treatment
response_to_treatment.example: Clinically improved with resolution of hypoxia.

discharge_plan_by_issue.description: Problem-based discharge plan: final diagnoses, the course/plan organized by issue, and consulting-service input.

plan_by_issue.description: Hospital course and plan organized by problem/issue
example: Pneumonia: IV ceftriaxone/azithromycin, transitioned to oral

consultations.description: Consulting services. Each entry has service, reason, key_recommendations.

discharge_exam.description: Patient status and exam at discharge.

vital_signs.example: BP 124/78, HR 72, RR 16, afebrile, SpO2 96% RA

functional_status.description: Mobility and activities of daily living

mental_status.description: Cognitive or mental status if documented

pain_level.description: Pain status at discharge if documented

laboratory_studies.description: Significant lab results, grouped by SHC panel (CBC, Electrolytes, Glucose, Coagulation, LFTs, Cardiac, Other) in the output.

laboratory.description: Key lab values as labeled key-value pairs with dates. Deterministically grouped into SHC panels by restructure.py.

imaging.description: Imaging, pathology, and other diagnostic studies.

other_studies.description: EKG, echo, PFTs, microbiology, or any other studies

procedures.description: All procedures performed during this admission.
Each entry has date, description, and findings.

complications.description: Complications during the stay. Empty array if none.

discharge_medications.description: Complete medication regimen at discharge with reconciliation.

medications.description: Each entry has name, dose, route, frequency, indication.

pending_labs.description: Tests ordered but not resulted at discharge.

pending.description: Each entry has test, ordered_date, expected_location, action_needed.

discharge_orders.description: Patient care orders, instructions, and education at discharge.

wound_care.description: Wound or incision care if applicable

monitoring.description: What to watch for at home
monitoring.example: Return if fever or worsening dyspnea

equipment.description: Durable medical equipment provided or ordered

appointments.description: Each entry has date, time, provider, department, phone.

recommendations.example: Follow up with PCP in 1 week.

best_practice_information.description: SHC best-practice block: cardiac quality attestation, goals-of-care/disposition, allergies, and the smoking and PRISM referring-physician footers.

cardiac_quality_attestation.static: BEST PRACTICE for patients with AMI or Heart Failure: quality cardiac topics reviewed and documented.

advance_directives.description: Healthcare proxy, living will, POLST if documented

support_services.description: Home health, VNA, PT/OT, case management

smoking_advisory.static: Patient has been advised to quit if currently smoking or to remain tobacco-free if quit within the last 12 months.

referring_physician_portal.static: Referring physicians can access information about the care provided to their patients at Stanford Hospital and Clinics using a secure, web-based portal called PRISM. Visit http://prism.stanfordmedicine.org for more details and to apply for a user account.

additional_information.description: Catch-all for anything not captured above.

clinical_details.description: Flexible labeled key-value pairs for any specialty-specific or uncategorized clinical information. Add whatever keys are relevant — do not omit information just because it lacks a dedicated field.
